title: Frozen Coffee Drink, Decaffeinated, with Whipped Cream

content.title: About
content.content: Frozen coffee drink, decaffeinated, with whipped cream is a refreshing treat made from cold-brew coffee that has had the caffeine removed and topped with a light layer of whipped cream. Served as a dense, ice‑cream‑like portion, it offers the rich flavor of coffee without the stimulating effects.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The drink combines the aromatic profile of coffee with the sweet, airy texture of whipped cream for a pleasant contrast.
Decaffeination is usually performed by water‑process or supercritical CO₂, preserving most flavor compounds.
Frozen coffee beverages are popular in warm climates where they are enjoyed as a summer dessert.
Whipped cream adds not only sweetness but also a perception of “softness” and “fluffiness”.
It is often served in wide‑rimmed glasses to enhance aroma perception.

items.title: Low caffeine content
items.content: The absence of caffeine makes the drink suitable for children, pregnant women, and individuals sensitive to stimulants.

items.title: Source of antioxidants
items.content: Coffee is rich in polyphenols, which help combat free radicals and support cellular health.

items.title: Calcium from cream
items.content: Whipped cream provides calcium, important for bone and teeth health.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Decaffeinated coffee retains vitamins B2 and B3, supporting energy metabolism.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: As a frozen beverage, it contains a substantial amount of water, contributing to fluid balance.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: The cream may cause discomfort for people who cannot digest lactose.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Sweeteners are often added; individuals monitoring blood glucose should watch portion size.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Whipped cream can trigger allergic reactions in those allergic to casein.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: Frozen coffee with cream is relatively calorie‑rich, so moderation is advised for weight management.

items.title: Additive presence
items.content: Some brands use artificial flavors and stabilizers; choose products with minimal ingredient lists.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the frozen coffee in a glass or cup, allowing the whipped cream to soften slightly. Sprinkle cocoa powder, grated chocolate, or nuts for extra flavor. Garnish with mint leaves or a dash of cinnamon if desired.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the frozen coffee at –18 °C in an airtight container. If you need to soften it, transfer to the refrigerator for a few hours. Use within two weeks to avoid ice crystal formation and flavor loss.
